name: Charles Kushner
moments: He explains France's move to recognize a Palestinian state and the letter in which Ambassador Charles Kushner accused Macron of not doing enough against antisemitism, reading New York Times coverage. He says France is carrying out stated US policy while the US and Israel condemn it.

He previews the night's stories: the Scottish axe girl and Shiloh Hendricks, both charged after confronting migrants, which he calls anarcho-tyranny. He also previews ambassador Charles Kushner's fight with France over antisemitism, which he says reflects an administration that mostly cracks down on antisemitism.
